scripts.db:migrations:list:production: wrangler d1 migrations list auction-domain-aggregator-production --remote --config wrangler.ingestion.jsonc --env production --env-file /dev/null
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply auction-domain-aggregator-production --remote --config wrangler.ingestion.jsonc --env production --env-file /dev/null
scripts.sync: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.ingestion.jsonc --env-file /dev/null && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.secrets/providers.env --import tsx scripts/sync-provider.ts
scripts.check:quick: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm db:check && pnpm test
scripts.check: pnpm check:quick && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.deploy:web: node -e "console.error('The website has no deployed environment yet: it waits for accounts and payments (#27).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.preview: pnpm db:migrate:local && opennextjs-cloudflare build && node --import tsx scripts/assert-no-bundled-env.ts && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
